chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 120C 'Lobbying' is NC's standalone lobbying-disclosure regime (registration, expenditure reporting, gift prohibitions) under the post-2006 ethics-reform consolidation, already in place by 2010.

notes: Chapter 120 (General Assembly) intentionally excluded (pre-2006 Article 9A lobbying regime, superseded). Chapter 138A (State Government Ethics Act, officials-side) intentionally excluded as out-of-scope. Chapter 163 (Elections) = campaign finance, excluded. Note 2010 slug convention is 'chapter120c' (no hyphen), differing from 2015's 'chapter-120c'.
